name: ONLY HARD
detailed_description:
Only Hard is an intense and unforgiving platformer where every second counts. You play as a character determined to climb a mountain of obstacles, but every mistake costs you dearly. The goal is simple: reach the top, but the path is filled with pitfalls, traps, and challenges that leave no room for error.

Each platform is a test of precision and timing. You’ll need to master complex jumps, avoid moving hazards, and navigate a variety of environmental elements that put your reflexes to the test. As you ascend, the terrain becomes increasingly difficult, and every fall sends you back to square one.

The environments are varied and breathtaking: from steep mountains to ruined urban landscapes, each level offers a unique atmosphere that enhances immersion. The difficulty is ever-present, but it’s also what makes every bit of progress even more rewarding.

The controls are simple, but each movement must be perfect to succeed. Solo players will quickly learn to master the game’s subtleties: jumping at the right time, avoiding traps, and knowing when to slow down or speed up. The game is designed to be brutal, but it’s precisely this challenge that makes victory so sweet.

Only Hard is not a game for the faint of heart. It will push you to your limits, test your patience, but with every attempt, you’ll get closer to the ultimate reward: reaching the top and savoring the sweet taste of success.
